title: Motion (Nazarian - Hutt) relative to establishing a pilot program to convert the existing parking lot gate at Whitnall Dog Park, located at 5801 1/2…
text:
[Council File 26-1548]
Motion (Nazarian - Hutt) relative to establishing a pilot program to convert the existing parking lot gate at Whitnall Dog Park, located at 5801 1/2 Whitnall Highway, to an automatic timed gate system that opens and closes in alignment with posted park hours.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Starts a pilot to replace the Whitnall Dog Park parking lot gate with an automatic timed gate that opens and closes with posted park hours.
